positions.as_written: Assess the extensor tendons on the sagittal images along their length.
Assess the hamstrings and popliteus on the axial and coronal images, where their courses are crossed.
Use a fluid sensitive sequence for peritendinous change and an intermediate weighting for the substance.
Check any bright tendon on a long echo time sequence, which is the direct test.
